sourceLabel: Coach reference — 三段长拳 San Duan Chang Quan

moves.name: Opening salute
moves.coachTip: Feet together, fists or palms at chest height.

moves.name: Horse stance ready
moves.coachTip: Wide horse stance, hands guarding the chest.

moves.name: Bow stance punch
moves.coachTip: Front knee bent in bow stance, punch straight ahead.

moves.name: Return fists to waist
moves.coachTip: Keep bow stance while both fists return to the waist.

moves.name: Empty stance block
moves.coachTip: Weight on rear leg, blocking hand in front of chest.

moves.name: Horse stance cross punch
moves.coachTip: Stable horse stance before the cross punch.

moves.name: Bow stance palm
moves.coachTip: Push palm forward with a clear bow stance.

moves.name: Closing salute
moves.coachTip: Return to center and salute to finish.
